description: Deterministically resolve a folder and apply per-video player config to every CONVERTED video (POST /player?type=video). Supports: default_subtitle (lang code or 'false'), default_audio (dubbing language code or 'false'), on_funnel, and the AI toggles questions/mindmap/abstract. Send only the fields you want to change. dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos.

default_audio.description: Default audio language — code of a dubbing the videos have (e.g. 'es') or 'false' for the original audio. Only takes effect with the dubbing item on in the gear menu and without lipsync.

default_subtitle.description: Default subtitle language code (e.g. 'pt-BR') or 'false' to disable

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

name: panda_action_apply_video_config_to_folder
title: Apply Video Config to Folder
